plate_findings.evidence: Tightness and hardness of the hands combined with joint contractures
Firm nodules establishing a cobblestone configuration
Tight and firm skin on lower legs

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Clinical photograph of a human nephrogenic systemic fibrosis patient demonstrating hand tightness, hardness, and joint contractures, a classic musculoskeletal manifestation of NSF. B: Clinical photograph of a human nephrogenic systemic fibrosis patient showing firm nodules forming a cobblestone (peau d'orange) skin configuration on the arm, a classic cutaneous manifestation of NSF. C: Clinical photograph of a human nephrogenic systemic fibrosis patient showing tight, firm indurated skin on the lower legs, a classic manifestation of NSF involving the lower extremities.

panels.figure_caption: Clinical photos from nephrogenic systemic fibrosis patients. A: Tightness and hardness of the hands combined with joint contractures. B: Firm nodules establishing a cobblestone configuration. C: Tight and firm skin on lower legs.
in_text_mentions: In case of suspected NSF, the patient was referred to a doctor experienced in NSF who undertook a clinical examination [14]. The clinical examination included a thorough evaluation of the skin (Figure 1). Some patients were also assessed with a modified Rodnan skin score [15] in order to grade the severity of the fibrosis, and blood tests were drawn to exclude diseases mimicking NSF. Deep punch biopsies were taken whenever clinical suspicion of NSF was raised.
